sources.recommend_reason_zh: GPT-6家族仅靠推理和代码设计蛋白质结构与序列；与Onava的实验室测试中，基于GPT-6.2设计的蛋白质在五个靶点上显示结合证据，重设计抗体也保持结合。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 这篇博客讲 Microduck 的 Sim2Real 避障流程：固定原行走策略权重，用 Newton raycaster 建模 ToF 传感，在 Isaac Lab 以 50 Hz 训练独立控制器调整 gamepad 速度指令，并覆盖训练、评估、导出和真机部署。

en.reason: Microduck's Sim2Real obstacle-avoidance workflow keeps the original walking policy fixed, models ToF sensing with Newton's raycaster, and trains an independent 50 Hz Isaac Lab controller to adjust gamepad velocity commands, covering training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 两位业余天文学家分别用Codex筛查Kepler约10万颗恒星、用Astra分析约1900万颗恒星数据，找到潜在系外行星并交SETI Institute和TESS团队复核。

en.reason: Two amateur astronomers used Codex to screen about 100,000 Kepler stars and Astra to analyze data from roughly 19 million stars, identifying potential exoplanets now sent to the SETI Institute and TESS team for review.

en.title: No "AI junk code": LibreOffice unveils its strictest AI coding rules yet — use an LLM to write code and you must first pass a human explanation checkpoint
en.reason: LibreOffice maintainer TDF sets four hard rules for LLM-assisted coding: AI patches must explain every changed line in the contributor’s own words, win approval and disclosure before submission, and cannot use LLMs for commit messages or comments.

en.title: Google open-sources AQuA, an environment quality agent for diagnosing AI agent failures in production
en.summary:
Google open-sources AQuA (Ambient Quality Agent), a reference implementation for analyzing production AI agent sessions, validating recurring failure patterns, and performing root-cause investigation of deployed source code. It targets silent quality regressions that traditional infrastructure monitoring may miss, such as agents ignoring user preferences.

AQuA is designed for offline analysis of the session quality of production AI agents, identifying silent regressions (such as skipped tool calls or ignored user preferences) and correlating them with immutable source snapshots for root-cause diagnosis. It supports sampling and a five-stage analysis workflow based on telemetry data (Trace/Logging/BigQuery); uses goal.md to configure domain quality standards and deterministic metrics; and its diagnostics can pinpoint root causes in code, prompts, external dependencies, etc., and provide suggested fixes.

Intended for AI engineers, MLOps engineers, and agent platform developers.
en.reason: Google open-sourced AQuA, an ambient quality agent that offline-analyzes production AI agent sessions, sampling up to 1,000 and using a five-stage flow; 32 travel-app sessions confirmed 6 issues, with seat-validation bypasses falling from 15 to 2 after fixes.

en.title: How Uber Evaluates More Than a Million Agent Skill Invocations a Month
en.summary: With more and more Skills being written, how do you know which ones are actually useful and which are just burning extra tokens? Uber’s Skill library has surpassed 5,000, with over a million invocations a month. This engineering retrospective shares their management approach.

This blueprint describes how Snowflake’s sales and marketing teams bridged the gap between AI pilot exploration and real business results. Our transformation journey was not a smooth one. Some pilots performed exceptionally well in demo scenarios but ran into integration bottlenecks when scaled. These issues prompted us to course-correct promptly and establish metrics for verifiable outcomes.

sources.title_zh: Octop 托管 CodeBuddy 实战：打造 7×24 小时在线的 AI 程序员
sources.title_original: Octop 托管 CodeBuddy 实战：打造 7×24 小时在线的 AI 程序员
sources.summary:
本文字数：3597 字
阅读完需：约 12 分钟
Octop 开源平台支持创建可统一调度的“托管专家”，实现多编程智能体（如 CodeBuddy、Claude Code 等）在本地工作目录中完成端到端开发任务。其基于多 Agent 架构，单进程集成 Web/CLI/IM 入口与 OAuth+MCP Connector，支持私有部署与 IDE 双向协作。
托管专家是 Octop 的核心对话入口，支持按领域配置技能、子 Agent 与知识库；多通道接入覆盖飞书、钉钉、微信等主流 IM；ACP 协议实现与终端/IDE 工具链深度协同。
适合 AI 工程师、DevOps 工程师、研发效能工程师阅读。
导读
本文介绍如何在 Octop 中创建“ 托管专家 ”（一种将 编程智能体 常驻托管于平台内、可被统一调度的 AI 专家），并将它与 CodeBuddy 、 OpenCode 、 Claude Code 、 Codex 等主流编程智能体对接。借助托管专家，你可以在对话中调度它们，在指定工作目录完成代码阅读、修改、测试与提交，所有操作都在 Octop 内完成，无需切换工具，打造自己的 7×24 小
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以 Ubuntu 服务器和 CodeBuddy 为例，实操在腾讯云开源的 Octop 中创建托管专家，让 CodeBuddy 在指定仓库目录完成拉取、修改与提交，并接入飞书、微信等 IM 实现 7×24 小时在线响应。

en.title: Hands-on: Hosting CodeBuddy on Octop to Build a 24/7 AI Programmer
en.summary:
Word count: 3,597 · Reading time: ~12 minutes

The Octop open-source platform lets you create centrally orchestrated "managed experts" that run end-to-end development tasks with multiple coding agents (such as CodeBuddy and Claude Code) inside a local working directory. Built on a multi-Agent architecture, it integrates Web/CLI/IM entry points and an OAuth+MCP Connector in a single process, and supports private deployment and two-way collaboration with IDEs.

Managed experts are Octop's core conversational entry point, allowing skills, sub-Agents and knowledge bases to be configured per domain. Multi-channel access covers major IM platforms including Feishu, DingTalk and WeChat, while the ACP protocol enables deep coordination with terminal and IDE toolchains.

Intended for AI engineers, DevOps engineers and R&D productivity engineers.

Introduction: This article explains how to create a "managed expert" in Octop — an AI expert that keeps a coding agent resident inside the platform and can be centrally orchestrated — and connect it to mainstream coding agents such as CodeBuddy, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex. With managed experts, you can dispatch them from a conversation to read, modify, test and commit code in a specified working directory, all within Octop and without switching tools, building your own 24/7 ...
en.reason: Octop, Tencent Cloud's open-source multi-agent platform, lets you create a hosted expert that runs CodeBuddy in a designated repository directory to pull, modify and commit code, connect it to Feishu and WeChat for round-the-clock responses, and coordinate Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex without switching tools.

从传统软件工程到 Agent 架构，一场正在发生的工程层权力转移
传统软件工程的"经典时代"（60年代到2000年初）基本是欧美人的主场：Dijkstra、Knuth、Linus、Martin Fowler、Eric Evans、Uncle Bob……定义"什么是好架构"的那批人，几乎清一色西方背景。
到了 AI 时代画风确实变了：
LLM 底层与 Agent 架构的领域里，华人面孔明显增多。这不是错觉，而是几条线交汇的结果。但要把这件事说清楚，需要先厘清一个容易被忽略的区分。
说华人在创业公司、工程落地、开源实现层面活跃，这成立。梁文锋、杨植麟、唐杰、阿里 Qwen 团队、闫俊杰这批人，已经直接站上了牌桌。
但在"定范式、定叙事"的层面——Hinton、LeCun、Bengio、Ilya、Dario——仍是欧美背景主导。华人更擅长把范式做出来、做得快、做得便宜（DeepSeek 是典型），而不是定义"
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借DeepSeek Harness一周2万star、北大×DeepSeek将effect/coeffect抬到运行时机制等细节，辨析华人团队在Agent工程架构层成为议题设置者，而Transformer、RLHF等科学范式层仍由欧美背景主导。

en.title: The "classic era" of traditional software engineering was largely a Western home game: Dijkstra, Knuth, Linus, Martin Fowler, Eric Evans, Uncle Bob… In the AI era, the picture has changed: He Kaiming and Sun Jian's ResNet; then this wave of LLMs—Liang Wenfeng (DeepSeek), Yang Zhilin (Kimi), Tang Jie (Zhipu), Alibaba Qwen, Yan Junjie (MiniMax)…

From traditional software engineering to Agent architecture, an engineering-level power shift is underway
The "classic era" of traditional software engineering (from the 1960s to the early 2000s) was largely a Western game: Dijkstra, Knuth, Linus, Martin Fowler, Eric Evans, Uncle Bob... the people who defined "what good architecture is" were almost all from Western backgrounds.
In the AI era, the picture has indeed changed:
In the fields of LLM foundations and Agent architecture, Chinese faces have become noticeably more numerous. This is not an illusion but the result of several threads converging. Still, to explain this clearly, we first need to clarify a distinction that is easy to overlook.
It is true that Chinese people are active in startups, engineering implementation, and open-source implementation. Liang Wenfeng, Yang Zhilin, Tang Jie, the Alibaba Qwen team, and Yan Junjie have already taken seats at the table.
But at the level of "setting paradigms and setting narratives"—Hinton, LeCun, Bengio, Ilya, Dario—Western backgrounds still dominate. Chinese people are better at building out paradigms, doing it quickly and cheaply (DeepSeek is a typical example), rather than defining
en.reason: DeepSeek's Liang Wenfeng, Kimi's Yang Zhilin, Zhipu's Tang Jie, Alibaba's Qwen team and MiniMax's Yan Junjie now sit at the table, though the split that matters is engineering versus paradigm-setting, still led by Hinton, LeCun, Bengio, Ilya and Dario.

sources.summary:
本文字数：1911 字
阅读完需：约 6 分钟
AI Agent 正从辅助工具演进为可承担端到端任务的工作主体，企业落地核心挑战转向任务界定、结果验收与权限/成本/风险治理。
Agent 长上下文瓶颈不在窗口长度，而在音视频等敏感数据无法上云导致记忆不可用；端侧需支持高敏数据的结构化记忆调用；真实生产中需权衡人工介入率、运行成本与系统鲁棒性。
适合AI平台工程师、Agent架构师、企业AI治理负责人阅读。
AI 正在从回答问题的辅助工具，走向能够理解目标、调用系统并完成任务的工作承担者。当 Agent 真正进入企业流程，挑战不再只是「如何把 AI 做出来」，而是哪些工作可以交给 AI、如何验收结果，以及怎样管理它的权限、成本与风险。

前阵子在X上分享了自己爬出来的4000多条2026年国自然新立项数据，没想到引来特别多关注。后台甚至有人私信，想付费让我再多采一些，但确实精力有限，后来就没再更新。这阵子课结了，年度考核也忙完了，接下来我打算专心干两件事：继续分享AI在科研里的用法，顺便正式申报国自然。
说实话，我本来挺佛系的，但今年扩容这么猛，身边好几个朋友都中了青基，天天催着我「上进」。再加上明年是我40岁前搭上 青基末班车 的最后一年，我彻底动心了，干脆不等过年，现在就先动起来。
我平时用AI写东西之前，习惯先搭一个知识库，让它先看看什么是好内容。准备国自然也一样，我想把已经获批的申请书和结题报告收进来，让AI先学学中标项目的写法和风格。结果第一步就卡住了：国自然官网上的结题报告只能在线预览，没法直接下载。
另外，在定选题之前，我习惯先大量翻看近3年刚获批的项目名单。这些最新立项不只是青年老师找

A few days ago I paid $99.99 for a year of official Google AI Pro, and went ahead and installed Google's coding and agent workbench Antigravity (AGY) on my computer.
That works out to about ¥60/month, and what you get is genuinely solid:
• Gemini 4 Neon (steady across UI aesthetics, long-form writing, coding, and reading tables and images)
• A separately metered Claude Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 quota pool inside the Antigravity client
• 5TB of official cloud storage
The key thing is it's a direct official subscription. Those cheap ready-made accounts or student-verified accounts going for a few dozen yuan outside have been losing their subscriptions constantly these past two months—your perks vanish mid-project, and migrating your workspace is a total morale killer.
But after I shared this with friends over the past few days, my inbox filled up with error screenshots: new accounts they registered themselves getting banned instantly, getting locked out for hastily changing passwords, accidentally buying Plus, which can't use Neon, Antigravity spinning endlessly, and even
